content: Node: insertBefore() method - Web APIs | MDN: The insertBefore() method of the Node interface inserts a node before a reference node as a child of a specified parent node. If referenceNode is null, newNode is inserted at the end of node's child nodes. If the given node already exists in the document, it is moved from its current position. Baseline: Widely available (since July 2015).
conclusion: 支持在清空回滚或 DOM 异常恢复时，将原输入节点准确插回原父节点及 nextSibling 位置，保障唯一输入框与 DOM 拓扑原子恢复。
